pests.value: Low  Probability  Of  Heatwave  Conditions  Likely  During  Some  Days  Of  The  Week  Over  Rajasthan  &Amp; Adjoining Punjab &Amp; Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, &Amp; Vidarbha. Appreciably Above Normal Maximum Temperatures Are Likely Over Some Parts Of Jammu &Amp; Kashmir, And Above-Normal Maximum Temperatures (+1.6 To +3.0°C) Are Likely Over Most Parts Of Northwest &Amp; Central India, And Many Parts Of The East &Amp; Northeast, And The West Coast Of India. Near-Normal Weekly Maximum Temperatures Are Likely In Isolated Places Over The Rest Of The Country
pests.evidence:  Low  Probability  of  Heatwave  conditions  likely  during  some  days  of  the  week  over  Rajasthan  & adjoining Punjab & Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, & Vidarbha. Appreciably above normal maximum temperatures are likely over some parts of Jammu & Kashmir, and above-normal maximum temperatures (+1.6 to +3.0°C) are likely over most parts of Northwest & Central India, and many parts of the East & Northeast, and the West coast of India. Near-normal weekly maximum temperatures are likely in isolated places over the rest of the country.
